newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian T-bill tranche yields average 53.09 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russian T-bill tranche yields average 53.09 pct.

text.p: The average yield on a new tranche of six-month GKO discount Treasury bills fell to 53.09 percent at an auction on Wednesday from 56.96 percent at the previous auction of six-month paper on October 23, the central bank said.
The earlier tranche of the issue, series number 22042, closed on Tuesday at a yield of 51.95 percent, and dealers had forecast the yield on the new tranche in a 49.90-60.82 percent range.
Issue volume 3.00 trln rbls 8.00 trln rbls
The issue yielded an average 93.99 percent when it was first sold on July 24.
On October 30 the finance ministry also auctioned nine trillion roubles in a new issue of six-month T-bills (series 22056), raising 5.71 trillion roubles at an average 58.46 percent yield.
Proceeds from the two auctions were about 7.8 trillion roubles, just enough to repay the 7.79 trillion roubles of six-month T-bills (series 22031) maturing on Wednesday.
